title: Tata and Besi Partner on Advanced Packaging: How It Supports India's Semiconductor Back-End Process
excerpt: We explain the advanced packaging partnership with Besi that Tata Electronics announced on September 17, 2026. We cover the role of the back-end process, the equipment support and training under consideration, how it differs from the existing $3 billion investment plan, and what to watch on the road to volume production.
